# Crypto: Flat Files API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-15 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

3 Flat Files endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Feeds

### Day Aggregates

`S3 /crypto/day-aggregates` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/crypto/day-aggregates.md)

Candlesticks with open, high, low, close, and volume at per day granularity across an expansive set of crypto pairings as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `close high low open ticker transactions volume window_start`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter EOD · history Starter all

### Minute Aggregates

`S3 /crypto/minute-aggregates` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/crypto/minute-aggregates.md)

Candlesticks with open, high, low, close, and volume at per minute granularity across an expansive set of crypto pairings as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `close high low open ticker transactions volume window_start`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter EOD · history Starter all

### Trades

`S3 /crypto/trades` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/crypto/trades.md)

Tick-level trades with nanosecond timestamps across an expansive set of crypto pairings, made available as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `conditions exchange id participant_timestamp price size ticker`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter EOD · history Starter all
